page_placements.theme: Weight edits can remove refusal incompletely (single rank-1 passes, skipped residual writers, low-bit edits)

record.file_problem: Repository code was not read or run; the available text is the README and file list.
record.tranche_reason: The README reports a weight-transplant ablation and refusal-related outcomes in a released model pack, but does not report the original difference-in-means intervention.
record.gate_note: The README reports a 32-prompt gate outcome for the Dealign transplant and separately says a rank-1 projection on oQ4 stayed at 19/32, without defining that metric or giving the projection setup. Speed and prefill measurements do not bear on the claim.
record.test_reason: This is a runtime and weight distribution pack. Abliteration is used as a tool: the refusal-related layers are BF16 o_proj weights transplanted from a donor (Dealign) for layers 15–45. The only refusal figure is a pass/fail check of the shipped pack (32/32 bypass), with no prompt set, no scoring rule, no unedited baseline and no capability check. The README never says the transplanted weights come from a difference-in-means direction ablation. The 'rank-1 projection … stayed 19/32' remark gives no direction, layers, metric or baseline. None of this tests whether the direction mediates refusal or whether such edits remove it in general.
record.authors_conclusion: Largely right, with additions. The README says the weights have safety refusals removed. It reports 32/32 bypass, 0 refusals and 0 garbled outputs on its 32-prompt gate, using BF16 donor o_proj for layers 15–45. It says the affine-requant / rank-1 projection path on oQ4 'stayed 19/32'. Its main focus is decode and prefill speed on a Mac M3 Ultra.
record.recipe_differences: This is a model-weight and runtime distribution pack, not a reproduction of the original difference-in-means method. It uses a Dealign o_proj L15–45 and MTP transplant; the README also mentions a rank-1 projection result but does not specify its setup.
record.method_sensitivity: The README distinguishes the Dealign transplant result (32/32 bypass) from a rank-1 projection result (19/32), but does not define the latter metric or its setup.

fits_no_version.finding: A rank-1 projection on the 4-bit quantized (oQ4) model, or affine requantization of the edited weights, reportedly reached only 19/32 on the pack's gate. Keeping the transplanted o_proj weights in BF16 reached 32/32.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Abliteration edits applied to, or requantized into, low-bit quantized weights may remove refusal less completely than full-precision edits (anecdotal, undefined metric).

record.problems: The prompt set, gate scoring, and refusal baseline are not described. No capability evaluation or uncertainty estimates are reported. The rank-1 projection result is not defined sufficiently to interpret.
record.rows_left_out: No relevant results were omitted. Speed and prefill benchmarks do not test the claim.

untested.parts: Difference-in-means direction, ablation removing refusal, addition inducing refusal, capability retention: none reported.
Refusal rate before vs after a direction-ablation weight edit, prompt set, capability cost: not reported; edit is a donor transplant of unstated origin.

record.verdict_notes: GitHub pack with 6 stars and no methods description, so this is engineering anecdote, not a study. The record's 'tests'/T2 and its V2 'supports' label are not justified: there is no baseline, the prompt set is unknown, and the edit's link to the refusal direction is unstated. Speed and prefill results are irrelevant to the claim.

versions.untested_parts: The README does not state that the projected direction was the harmful-minus-harmless difference in means, which layers or positions were projected, or whether adding the direction or general capabilities were tested.
The README does not describe the 32 prompts, give a refusal baseline for the unabliterated model, or report the effect on general capabilities.
No jailbreak suppression or training against ablation is reported.
No comparison of affine, cone, or multiple-direction accounts is reported.
No separate measurement of harmfulness judgment and refusal decision is reported.
No cross-language, model-variant, or base-to-instruct transfer test is reported.
No comparison of refusal-training methods or timing is reported.

statements.correction: Shipped pack: Vontra oQ4 plus Dealign BF16 o_proj for L15–45 and MTP, L0–14 stock. 32-prompt gate, greedy 192 tok, thinking off: 32/32 bypass, 0 refuse, 0 garble. Affine requant path: 'stayed 19/32'. Rank-1 projection on oQ4: 'stayed 19/32'. No prompt set, judge or stock refusal count given.
statements.problem: Small imprecisions only. oQ4 is a mixed-bit quant (KDA 5-bit q/v, 8-bit k), and the text treats uniform 4-bit as a different checkpoint. The gate does name its counts ('32/32 bypass, 0 refuse, 0 garble'), but gives no prompts and no rule for scoring bypass. The text does not say outright that 19/32 comes from the same 32-prompt gate.
